name: perish clock clears on switch-out ('went back to' recall wording, battle 5)

tokens.text: In sent out Gengar and Incineroar!
All Pokémon that heard the song will faint in three turns!
The opposing Incineroar went back to U3 d!
The opposing Incineroar's perish count fell to 2!

notes: The count line after withdrawal must not re-clock the benched mon — lookup resolves it but it is no longer active... actually resolve finds the entity; the assertion here is intentionally only that withdrawal parsed. Perish-after-withdraw is legal narration order; drop the forbid if Champions narrates counts before recall completes.
